title: Self-healing X12: a deterministic incident detector writes typed incident records from signals, breaches, red main and stalls
summary: The north star of 2026-10-25 asks the loop to detect an error or an accident itself. Detection must be deterministic. Sources: Signal Center WARN and INCIDENT signals, QUALITY_*_BREACH, ISOLATION_* at enforce, red main or CI, zero-ship streaks, system-level failure digests. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §18.1, §18.2, §22 and §24.
fix: Add the detector and the record .evolve/incidents/<id>.json (protected path) with id, class, sources, tier, state, attempts, repro_test, opened_at, closed_at. Add the healing module and the incident kinds and codes of spec §24. Implement the four close conditions of I-14. Stage shadow: open and close records only.
acceptance: RED first: a red main and a QUALITY_PQ1_BREACH open no incident record today; after the change each opens one
A level-triggered pass reopens an incident whose signal still fires after a missed event
evolve signals codes check passes; changed functions at 100% coverage
